sources.kind: historical observational study, not an aircraft specification

observations.planform: Broadly parallel-chord inner wing and tapered outer hand wing.

derivation.note: Both lengths use the same rounded Say column. Feet cancel in b^2/S. The page's printed 8.29 is not substituted for the calculation.

sources.kind: historical qualitative mechanics and control discussion
observations: The arm/inner wing and hand/outer wing articulate differently.
Recovery includes trailing and partial closing of the hand wing.
The discussion recommends conventional tail or weight-shift control for a simple ornithopter rather than full bird-like differential manoeuvring.
A fin/rudder and longer tail moment arm are suggested as advantageous for an ornithopter.
sources.use: Separate shoulder and wrist pivots plus a conventional horizontal stabilizer, elevator, fixed fin and hinged rudder; not an inferred quantitative drive blueprint.

biomimetic_translation.planform_realization: The projected unflapped span is 3 m. A 0.22 m stationary centre carry-through and two 0.64 m moving inner panels make the 1.5 m wrist span. Each tapered outer panel is 0.75 m long. Constant inner chord C and assumed outer tip/root ratio 0.28 give S = C*(1.5 + 0.75*(1+0.28)). Thus the actual modelled wing planform matches the derived area, including its centre carry-through but excluding the tail.
biomimetic_translation.mechanism: Electric motor and reduction housing drive an eccentric, paired connecting rods and shoulder bellcranks. Each wing has actual nested shoulder and wrist nodes. A wrist servo and horn indicate independent outer articulation. Inner motion is sinusoidal; outer motion is phase-offset and changes relative to its own inner wing. Opposite rotation signs produce symmetric left/right strokes.
biomimetic_translation.controls: Actual elevator and rudder surfaces deflect. The educational dynamics command pitch and bank directly, and use the specified rudder side-force law. The tail geometry provides mechanical control context, not an independently solved tail aerodynamic model.
biomimetic_translation.engineering_identity: Tapered equipment pod, battery tray, carbon tail boom, spars, rib caps, metal bearings, gearbox, motor, servo horns, and three-wheel braced landing gear. No scaled bird head, neck, body outline or feather construction.

engineering_assumptions.status: New proposed benchmark assumptions for review; not measured aircraft data and not attributed to the historical author.
engineering_assumptions.relationship_to_engineering_json: The task's supplied ENGINEERING ASSUMPTIONS are transcribed here because interpretation.json is the writable engineering record; shared files are not changed.
engineering_assumptions.density_use: Use environment.rho; nominal density is only a missing-input fallback.

additional_geometry_choices.wing_skin: Opaque membrane/composite panel depiction with visible spar and rib caps.
additional_geometry_choices.drive: 400 W electric motor, reduction gearing and schematic eccentric/connecting rods; independent wrist actuation.
additional_geometry_choices.power_off: Phase is held by physics; wing panels return to a fully extended glide pose.

flight_model.type: Cycle-averaged point-mass translation with commanded attitude, educational approximation
flight_model.axes: x forward, y up, z right; positive heading turns x toward z
flight_model.directions: Drag opposes relative flow; thrust follows it. Lift is projected world up, banked about flow. At zero speed the flow fallback is horizontal heading; at vertical flow the lift reference fallback is horizontal heading.
flight_model.heading: Horizontal velocity direction above 0.1 m/s
flight_model.integrator: Semi-implicit Euler, 1/120 s production step; legal larger dt values subdivided into steps no larger than 1/120 s. Reject dt outside (0,0.05]. Forces evaluated before attitude update.
flight_model.ground: Sample environment.surfaceHeight under all three YZX-rotated wheel centres. Include wheel radius and project root upward only to resolve penetration. Cancel downward force while supported, never upward lift. No prescribed takeoff or altitude lock.
flight_model.braking: Up to 18 N opposing horizontal velocity on contact, capped to avoid reversal
flight_model.touchdown: Landed only if sink <=3 m/s, horizontal speed <=14 m/s and abs(roll)<=0.35; otherwise crashed. Safe landings retain horizontal motion for rollout. Crashed motion stops.

limitations: Not a real-world airworthiness claim or a human-carrying aircraft.
No validated motor/gearbox efficiency, battery endurance, stress, fatigue or aeroelastic calculation.
Visible mechanism is a kinematic schematic; connecting rods resize to close the animation and are not a solved fixed-length linkage synthesis.
Wingbeat animation does not introduce hidden impulses: all propulsion comes from the prescribed cycle-averaged 400 W model.
Tail surfaces are real articulated geometry but moments, rotational inertia, slip dynamics and dynamic stability are not solved.
The specified CL clamp is not a resolved stall, and the model omits Reynolds effects, feather porosity, unsteady flapping aerodynamics and ground effect.

Ground reaction is a vertical wheel-clearance constraint, not a suspension or tyre friction solver. Only wheel contacts are modelled; wing or fuselage strikes and tree collisions are not separately resolved.
Low-poly opaque panel surfaces and exposed rib/spar caps are engineering visualization, not manufacturing drawings. Geometry is reused and comfortably below the 12000-triangle budget.
No execution, rendering or verification was performed in this one-attempt submission.
